rationale: Tripling the door clamp. The dropped fact provably sits past 4000 chars at an unknown offset; 12000 buys real margin while keeping the clamp as a guard against pathological outputs. A single blunt knob turn — the failure is mechanical truncation, so the fix should be mechanical too, not instructional.

proposer_detail: claude-fable-5, in-session (Claude Code) — mining and proposal done as reasoning, per todo-begin-self-improvement-loop.md
rationale: The 12k clamp raise paired with window headroom: doubling default_context_limit keeps a single max-size item from consuming three quarters of the window, so the clamp fix does not starve everything else. Two knobs, but one story — raise the door and widen the room behind it.
expected_effect: A2 recovers as in clamp-12k, with less compaction churn from big items; sessions compact roughly half as often overall.
regression_risk: Changes compaction timing suite-wide, and in both directions: A1's setup requires compaction to actually fire within its filler budget — a doubled window delays that, and if compaction never fires the task fails as error. The doubled window also means more raw history (rather than a curated summary) in context, which can worsen drift/misattribution (A3).
